pillowcase.title: Pillowcase Care
pillowcase.full:
Your pillowcase accumulates oil, bacteria, and dead skin cells every night. These can clog your pores and cause breakouts.

✓ Change pillowcases 2-3 times per week
✓ Use cotton or silk fabric (avoid synthetics)
✓ Wash with fragrance-free detergent
✓ Consider having 4-6 pillowcases in rotation

This simple habit can significantly reduce acne breakouts and improve skin clarity.

cotton.title: Cotton Pads
cotton.short: The right way to apply products
cotton.full:
Cotton pads help apply products evenly and hygienically without transferring bacteria from your hands.

✓ Use 100% cotton rounds (avoid synthetic blends)
✓ Perfect for toners and essences
✓ Apply with gentle patting motions
✓ Never rub or drag across skin
✓ Use separate pads for different products

This ensures even product distribution and prevents contamination.

phone.title: Phone Hygiene
phone.full:
Your phone touches your face multiple times daily and harbors more bacteria than most surfaces.

✓ Wipe screen with alcohol wipes 2× daily
✓ Use speakerphone when possible
✓ Never place phone on dirty surfaces
✓ Consider using earbuds for calls

Reducing phone-to-face contact can prevent jawline and cheek acne.

hair.title: Hair Products
hair.short: Keep hair products away from your face
hair.full:
Hair products can migrate to your skin and cause clogged pores, especially along the hairline and forehead.

✓ Tie hair back during skincare routine
✓ Rinse hair products thoroughly in shower
✓ Apply hair products away from hairline
✓ Use non-comedogenic hair products when possible
✓ Wash pillowcase after using heavy styling products

This prevents pomade acne and forehead breakouts.

towel.title: Towel Hygiene
towel.short: Use clean towels for your face
towel.full:
Damp towels are breeding grounds for bacteria that can transfer to your freshly cleansed skin.

✓ Use a dedicated face towel separate from body towels
✓ Change face towel every 2-3 days
✓ Pat dry gently, never rub
✓ Consider disposable face towels for acne-prone skin
✓ Wash towels in hot water with gentle detergent

This simple change prevents re-contamination after cleansing.

hydration.title: Hydration
hydration.full:
Proper hydration supports skin cell function and helps flush out toxins that can contribute to breakouts.

✓ Aim for 8 glasses (2 liters) of water daily
✓ Drink more during exercise or hot weather
✓ Hydrated skin heals faster from acne
✓ Water helps regulate oil production
✓ Supports overall skin barrier function

Dehydrated skin can overproduce oil, leading to more breakouts.

sun.title: Sun Protection
sun.short: SPF every day, rain or shine
sun.full:
UV damage worsens acne scars and can trigger inflammation in acne-prone skin.

✓ Apply SPF 30-50 broad-spectrum daily
✓ Reapply every 2 hours when outdoors
✓ Choose oil-free, non-comedogenic formulas
✓ Mineral sunscreens (zinc oxide) are gentler
✓ SPF prevents dark spots from acne

Consistent sun protection is crucial for preventing post-acne marks.

hands.title: Hand Hygiene
hands.full:
Touching your face transfers bacteria, oil, and dirt from your hands directly into your pores.

✓ Avoid touching face during the day
✓ Never pop or pick at pimples
✓ Wash hands before skincare routine
✓ Use tissues instead of fingers when needed
✓ Be conscious of unconscious face-touching

This single habit can dramatically reduce breakouts.

smartRoutine.subtitle: Get a targeted routine to address your specific skin issue
smartRoutine.info: These advanced routines complement your basic Day and Night routines. Focus on one concern at a time for best results.

concerns.marks_desc: Dark spots and red marks from acne

smartRoutine.selection: Perfect! We'll create a targeted routine for {{concern}}
smartRoutine.helper_unselected: Choose a concern to focus on
smartRoutine.nodules_description: Deep, painful bumps that form beneath the skin surface. Requires gentle, anti-inflammatory approach.
smartRoutine.nodules_goal: Calm inflammation, regulate oil, and prevent infection without stripping skin barrier.
smartRoutine.nodules_am_step1_desc: Non-stripping formula to cleanse without irritation
smartRoutine.nodules_am_step2_desc: Light gel-cream to maintain skin barrier
smartRoutine.nodules_tip1: Never pop or touch nodules - they form deep beneath the skin
smartRoutine.nodules_tip2: Use disposable cotton pads instead of towels to prevent bacteria spread
smartRoutine.nodules_tip4: Apply ice wrapped in gauze for 30 seconds to reduce swelling
smartRoutine.nodules_tip5: Introduce actives slowly - start 2x per week
smartRoutine.blackheads_description: Oxidized sebum in open pores. Requires chemical exfoliation to dissolve buildup.
smartRoutine.blackheads_goal: Dissolve oxidized sebum and keep pores clear with BHA exfoliants.
smartRoutine.blackheads_pm_step1_desc: Oil-based balm first if using sunscreen
smartRoutine.blackheads_tip1: Avoid physical scrubs or pore strips - they damage the barrier
smartRoutine.blackheads_tip2: Steam once weekly before BHA application to enhance penetration
smartRoutine.blackheads_tip3: Never over-cleanse - skin should never feel tight
smartRoutine.blackheads_tip4: Be patient - results take 6-8 weeks of consistent use
smartRoutine.blackheads_tip5: Don't mix BHA with retinoids on the same night
smartRoutine.whiteheads_description: Closed pores filled with sebum and dead skin. Needs cell turnover acceleration.
smartRoutine.whiteheads_goal: Accelerate cell turnover and prevent clogged follicles with retinoids.
smartRoutine.whiteheads_tip1: Never pick or squeeze whiteheads - causes scarring
smartRoutine.whiteheads_tip2: Introduce retinoids slowly: 2x per week for first month
smartRoutine.whiteheads_tip3: Always use SPF when using retinoids - increased sun sensitivity
smartRoutine.whiteheads_tip4: Sleep on clean pillowcases changed every 2-3 days
smartRoutine.whiteheads_tip5: Remove all makeup thoroughly every night
smartRoutine.papules_description: Surface acne with bacterial involvement. Requires antimicrobial treatment.
smartRoutine.papules_goal: Kill acne bacteria and reduce inflammation with benzoyl peroxide and niacinamide.
smartRoutine.papules_tip1: Never apply BP and retinoids at the same time - alternate nights
smartRoutine.papules_tip2: Use cotton pillowcases (not synthetic) and change frequently
smartRoutine.papules_tip3: BP can bleach fabrics - use white towels and sheets
smartRoutine.papules_tip4: Start with 2.5% BP - higher isn't always better
smartRoutine.papules_tip5: Moisturize before BP application to reduce irritation
smartRoutine.marks_description: Dark spots and red marks left after acne heals. Requires brightening and barrier support.
smartRoutine.marks_goal: Fade dark/red spots with brightening actives while maintaining strong barrier.
smartRoutine.marks_tip1: SPF every day, even indoors - UV darkens marks
smartRoutine.marks_tip2: Avoid 'miracle' spot creams with harsh acids
smartRoutine.marks_tip3: Use soothing sheet masks (Dr. Jart Cicapair, Beauty of Joseon)
smartRoutine.marks_tip4: Be patient - fading takes 6-12 weeks minimum
smartRoutine.marks_tip5: Never pick at acne - causes more marks

test1.subtitle: Check your skin 2-3 hours after cleansing
test1.instructions_text: Cleanse your face normally, wait 2-3 hours without applying any products, then answer these questions.
test1.question: How does your skin feel right now?

test2.title: Blotting Paper
test2.subtitle: Use blotting paper to determine your skin's oil production
test2.what_is_text: Thin, absorbent paper sheets that soak up oil from your skin. You can find them at drugstores, beauty stores, or use clean tissue paper as an alternative.
test2.how_to_text:
1. Start with clean skin (wash your face)
2. Wait 1-2 hours without applying products
3. Gently press blotting paper on different areas
4. Hold the paper up to light to see oil absorption

Complete these steps, then come back to record your results!
test2.question: What does the blotting paper show in your T-zone (forehead, nose, chin)?

test2Part2.title: Record Your
test2Part2.subtitle: Question 2 of 2

test3.title: Overnight
test3.subtitle: Check how your skin behaves while you sleep
test3.how_it_works_text: This test reveals your skin's natural oil production while you sleep - the most accurate way to understand your skin type!
test3.tonight_text:
1. Cleanse your face before bed
2. Don't apply any moisturizers or treatments
3. Sleep normally
test3.tomorrow_text:
4. Look in the mirror before washing your face
5. Notice how your skin feels and looks
6. Come back here to record your results!
test3.question: How does your skin feel when you wake up in the morning (before washing)?
test3.option_1: Very oily and greasy all over

test3Part2.subtitle: Question 2 of 2

comprehensiveNightStep4Info.intensive_text: Retinoids provide powerful pore refinement and texture improvement for oily skin. Start slowly and buffer if needed to build tolerance.
comprehensiveNightStep4Info.repair_text: Buffered retinoids or peptide serums provide anti-aging benefits while supporting barrier health. Choose peptides if skin is too reactive for retinoids.
comprehensiveNightStep4Info.balanced_text: Zone-specific retinoid application provides targeted treatment without over-drying. Buffer on dry areas, lighter application on T-zone.
comprehensiveNightStep4Info.professional_text: Your healthy skin can handle potent retinoids or peptide night creams for maximum anti-aging benefits. Choose based on tolerance and goals.
comprehensiveNightStep4Info.barrier_text: Rich ceramide creams or gentle bakuchiol alternatives provide benefits without irritation. Postpone traditional retinoids until barrier stays consistently calm.
comprehensiveNightStep4Info.oily_how: Apply 2-3 times per week after pore care treatment. Consider adapalene if acne-prone. Always use sandwich method: moisturizer → wait 5 min → retinoid → wait → moisturizer.
comprehensiveNightStep4Info.dry_how: Apply after hydrating essence. If using retinoid, buffer heavily: moisturizer → wait → retinoid → rich cream. Peptides can be used more frequently without buffering.
comprehensiveNightStep4Info.combo_how: Apply retinoid lightly on T-zone, buffer heavily on dry cheek areas. This zone-specific approach prevents over-treatment while providing benefits where needed.
comprehensiveNightStep4Info.normal_how: Start with retinoid 2-3 times per week, increasing as tolerated. Peptide night creams can be used more frequently. Results visible after 12+ weeks of consistent use.
comprehensiveNightStep4Info.sensitive_how: Apply after soothing serum. Ceramide creams strengthen barrier while gentle peptides or bakuchiol provide mild anti-aging benefits without retinoid irritation risk.

comprehensiveRoutineStep3Products.sensitive_explanation: Choose 1-2 barrier support serums to use every night. These strengthen your barrier while you sleep. No exfoliants needed - focus on building resilience.

comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.oily_intro: High-performance actives target excess oil production, enlarged pores, and acne prevention with professional-grade ingredients.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.dry_intro: Multi-layered hydration system delivers moisture at different skin depths for lasting comfort and barrier protection.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.combo_intro: Zone-specific treatment addresses different needs across your face with targeted active ingredients.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.normal_intro: Professional anti-aging protocol stimulates collagen production and cellular renewal for long-term skin health.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.sensitive_intro: Intensive barrier repair uses clinically-proven ingredients to strengthen your skin's protective function.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.oily_how: Apply 2-4 evenings per week after cleansing. Start with 2x/week and increase as tolerated. Use moisturizer after if needed.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.dry_how: Layer from thinnest to thickest: serum → essence → treatment. Allow 60 seconds between layers for optimal absorption.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.combo_how: Apply targeted treatments to specific zones: T-zone gets mattifying actives, cheeks get hydration. Blend carefully at borders.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.normal_how: Apply in evening after cleansing. Follow with moisturizer. Use 3-5x per week, increase gradually. Always use SPF 30+ in morning.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.sensitive_how: Apply gently morning and evening. Build tolerance slowly - start every other day, then increase to daily as skin adjusts.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.oily_warning: Never use with physical exfoliants same evening. Stop 3 days before professional treatments. Temporary purging (4-6 weeks) is normal.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.dry_warning: Avoid layering incompatible ingredients (vitamin C + retinol, AHA + BHA). If skin feels tight, reduce frequency and increase moisturizer.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.combo_warning: Do not apply T-zone products to cheeks and vice versa. Use separate applicators for each zone to prevent cross-contamination.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.normal_warning: Introduce one product at a time, waiting 4 weeks between additions. Temporary redness/flaking is normal initially. Reduce frequency if irritation persists.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Info.sensitive_warning: Patch test 48 hours before full application. If stinging occurs, apply moisturizer first (sandwich method). Skip days if inflammation appears.

comprehensiveRoutineStep4Products.oily_explanation: Choose 1 advanced treatment to use 2-3 times per week. Retinoids provide powerful pore refinement. Start slowly and buffer if needed to build tolerance.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Products.dry_explanation: Choose 1 treatment: buffered retinoid OR peptide serum. Peptides are gentler and can be used more frequently. Always layer with rich moisturizer on top.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Products.combo_explanation: Choose 1 treatment for zone-specific application. Apply lightly on T-zone, buffer heavily on dry cheeks. This balanced approach prevents over-treatment.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Products.normal_explanation: Choose 1 advanced treatment for maximum anti-aging benefits. Your healthy skin can handle potent actives. Start 2-3× per week and increase as tolerated.
comprehensiveRoutineStep4Products.sensitive_explanation: Choose 1 ultra-gentle treatment. Focus on barrier support with ceramides or try bakuchiol instead of traditional retinoids. Postpone retinoids until barrier is consistently calm.

comprehensiveRoutineStep4Products.citation: Advanced treatment recommendations based on research on topical retinoids for cellular renewal and anti-aging, studies on peptides and growth factors for collagen stimulation, and dermatological protocols for safe introduction of potent actives. These are educational suggestions - always patch test new products and consult a dermatologist for personalized treatment plans.

comprehensiveRoutineStep5Info.essential_text: Sunscreen is your #1 anti-aging and skin protection step. We've selected SPF 30+ options that work perfectly for your skin type.
comprehensiveRoutineStep5Info.why_text: Sunscreen prevents premature aging, dark spots, and skin damage. It's the most important step in any skincare routine - even more than active treatments.
comprehensiveRoutineStep5Info.tip_text: Apply 2-3 fingers' worth for face and neck. Never mix with skincare or makeup - it must be a standalone layer for full protection. Reapply every 2 hours when exposed to sun.
